tools.name: lynx_signup
tools.description: Create a no-KYC API key with an email. Returns sk-lynx-... key (0 credits).

tools.name: lynx_me
tools.description: Check credits + usage for a key.

tools.name: lynx_order
tools.description: Create a BTCPay invoice for credits. usd in {2,5,10,20}. Returns a checkout_link to pay in bitcoin.

tools.name: lynx_inspect_file
tools.description: Inspect a file (hashes, entropy, strings, metadata, PE/PDF/Office analysis). Pass file bytes as base64.

tools.name: lynx_steg_extract
tools.description: Extract hidden data (steghide + zsteg LSB). Optional passphrase.

tools.name: lynx_recon
tools.description: Run recon against an external target. tool in {nmap,subfinder,nuclei,theharvester,dnsrecon}.
